snippet.title: Train Sim World 6 - Expect the Unexpected | Official Trailer | Arriving 30th September 2025
snippet.description:
🚆 Train Sim World 6 – Expect the Unexpected!

Pre-Order now: https://bit.ly/Pre-Order-TSW6-Now-d

Embark on your next journey and master formidable trains across 3 new routes:

🌟 Morristown Line (NJ TRANSIT®) – Arrow III EMU, ALP-46 & MultiLevels

🌊 Riviera Line (UK)– Class 802 & Class 150/2, plus CrossCountry Class 220 in Deluxe

🇩🇪 Bahnstrecke Leipzig – Dresden – ICE-T, BR 442, freight & Deluxe BR 294

Free Starter Pack Available!

- Access the Training Centre and learn steam, diesel & electric traction.
- Try Free Roam, Livery Designer & Scenario Planner.
- Upgrade to TSW6 for free – your content comes with you!

New Features:

- Announcements on platforms & trains
- Random Events & Faults** for added realism
- Conductor Mode – check tickets & dispatch trains
- Photo Mode, Route Hopping, Creators Club & more!

💡 Choose Standard, Deluxe, or Special Edition to unlock even more trains & services.

👉 Pre-Order Train Sim World 6 – Expect the Unexpected!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Train Sim World 6 is arriving on 30th September 2025, to Xbox, PlayStation, Epic Games and Steam.
 
Expect the Unexpected!

Pre-Order your copy today: https://bit.ly/Pre-Order-TSW6-Now-d
 
Follow us on our social channels:
Facebook: https://bit.ly/32c9Jdn
Twitter: https://bit.ly/2TPAfVu
Instagram: https://bit.ly/362LaRx
 
ESRB Rating: Everyone | PEGI: 3 | USK: 3
 
#trainsimworld
